spec.name: gearbox_output_bracket
spec.description: Gearbox output bracket, 160 x 80 x 80 mm steel envelope. The x=0 end is bolted rigidly. A 40 N*m torque about +x is applied at the x=160 end face as a force couple through two 16x16 mm drive lugs. The lugs sit at the top and bottom edges, centred in y. Lug centres are 64 mm apart, so each lug carries 625 N.
